description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PerformanceReviewAPITest' for testing the PerformanceReviewAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It includes multiple test methods with data providers, focusing on API endpoints related to performance reviews, such as getAll, delete, create, update, and getOne. The class extends a custom test case 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase' and uses mock services and fixtures for testing.
